topic.title: The 2,000-Year-Old Computer Found in a Shipwreck — And Its Secret Code

script.full_text: The 2,000-Year-Old Computer Found in a Shipwreck — And Its Secret Code. Some stories hide in plain sight, waiting for someone to finally look a little closer. Trace it back to the very beginning, and a familiar thing starts to look strange and new. By the end, you will never quite see it the same way again.
